guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：乙太網路交換器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Ethernet switches
guides.concept: 以L2 學習、VLAN 與有限交換容量連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect l2 learning, vlans and finite switching capacity through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「框架欄位」的資料、控制與時間關係。來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類 L2 與 L3 位址。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Unknown flooding」的資料、控制與時間關係。未知單播可在允許域內泛洪。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對 ingress 與其他 port。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「環路風險」的資料、控制與時間關係。L2 環路可持續複製泛洪框架。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「紙上追蹤三交換器環路。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「隊頭阻塞」的資料、控制與時間關係。單一隊頭可能阻擋其他可送框架。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較單隊列與目的地隊列。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「最小框架率」的資料、控制與時間關係。小框架耗用固定線路 overhead。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「重算本課 14.881 Mframes/s。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「隔離驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。正向可通與負向拒絕均需測試。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「用虛構框架檢查 VLAN 規則。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for frame fields. Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify L2 and L3 addresses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for unknown flooding. Unknown unicast may flood within permitted domains. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check ingress and other ports. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for loop risks. L2 loops can keep replicating flooded frames. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace a three-switch loop on paper. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for head-of-line blocking. One head may block other feasible frames. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare single and destination queues. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for minimum-frame rates. Small frames pay fixed wire overhead. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Recalculate 14.881 Mframes/s. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for isolation acceptance. Allowed and denied paths both need testing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check VLAN rules with fictional frames. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「Link 聚合」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較多流與單流 hash。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「隔離驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「正向可通與負向拒絕均需測試。」。
提交「隔離驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「用虛構框架檢查 VLAN 規則。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit link aggregation input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit isolation acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit isolation acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：緩衝增加就能長期突破出口頻寬。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: More buffers permanently exceed egress bandwidth. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.
